disclaimer: Offline anti-phishing reference for demonstration. The legitimate-domain list (regulators, exchanges, depositories, and a NEUTRAL sample of registered intermediaries) is used ONLY to detect impersonation and look-alikes — it is NOT an endorsement, ranking, or recommendation of any entity. The scam-domain list is a small synthetic/illustrative sample, not a live blocklist.
feasibility: In production the legitimate set comes from official regulator/exchange/depository domains plus SEBI's registered-intermediary directory, and the scam set from live feeds (e.g. CERT-In / cybercrime reports). The detection logic needs no change.

reason.en: This link's domain closely imitates a regulator, exchange, or well-known broker — a changed letter, a digit swapped for a letter, or a different extension. Clones like this are built to steal logins and money.

action.en: Do not open it or enter any details. Type the official address yourself, or reach the company through an app you already trust.

citation.label: RBI/SEBI — advisories on cloned & phishing websites impersonating regulators and intermediaries

label.en: Trusted name used on an untrusted address

reason.en: A well-known regulator or broker name appears inside a web address that is not their official domain — a common trick to borrow credibility.

action.en: Ignore the familiar name in the link. Verify the real website independently before trusting or paying anyone.

citation.label: RBI/SEBI — advisories on cloned & phishing websites

reason.en: This link uses an uncommon domain extension together with pressure words such as KYC, verify, bonus, or reward — a combination frequently seen in financial phishing.

action.en: Treat it as unsafe until you confirm it independently. Never enter credentials, OTPs, or payment details from a link like this.

reason.en: This exact domain appears in our reference list of reported scam and phishing sites, used to impersonate regulators or brokers and harvest money or credentials.

action.en: Do not open it. If you have already entered details or paid, call 1930 and report at cybercrime.gov.in immediately.

detail.en: This matches an official regulator, exchange, depository, or a registered intermediary's known domain in our reference list. Still type addresses yourself and never follow a login link sent to you.
